study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: levator ani muscle (LAM) co-activation under Valsalva maneuver
cohort: 469 nulliparous women at term before the onset of labor
finding: In nulliparous women at term before the onset of labor fetal head regression and LAM co-activation at Valsalva are two distinct phenomena that uncommonly coexist.
mod_finding: Women with coexisting LAM co-activation and head regression had the highest risk of Cesarean delivery (40%).
